4.original: What do they think they're doing? Who are these guys?

6.original: How about we greet the noisy little animals?

8.original:
Wah hah hah hah!!

I think I overdid the greeting a bit!

9.original:
That's enough for now, Nappa...

We can't damage the planet too much or the price will go down when we sell it.

10.original:
Oh yeah!

Hey, Vegeta! We're gonna search for those things that will grant us any wish, right?

11.original:
The Dragon Balls.

First we need to find the one that killed Raditz and ask him about them...

12.original:
If the Dragon Balls were close by,

that greeting of yours would have destroyed our chances at wishing for eternal life.

14.original:
Now let's see... The one with the highest power level should be the one who killed Raditz.

Or maybe Kakarot's son...

15.original:
Hey, Vegeta! This is strange!

There're a bunch of power levels over 1000! How could that be...?

16.original:
Don't get shaken up. They're no match for us anyway.

Just find the one with the highest power level...

17.original:
!

Found them! Two high power levels are together...

All right! Nappa! Let's go have some fun!

18.original:
Heh heh heh. This is great!

The gravity is so low on this planet! It's really easy to move!

20.original:
They're heading towards two other strong Kis!

Maybe it's Tien and Chiaotzu. Or maybe Piccolo and Goku's son...

21.original: They're coming! They're coming right for us!

23.original: No, I'm going too! I trained for this! I'm going with you!

24.original:
The cause of the large earthquake is completely unknown!

Furthermore, we are very concerned over the welfare of East City,

which is believed to be the epicenter of the earthquake, as communications are completely cut off at this time...

26.original: Should we go cheer them on? We could find them with this!

27.original: I wouldn't go there if my life depended on it!

28.original:
No... We should stay out of it. It's too dangerous.

Even I would just be in the way.

All we can do is hope for their victory from here.

32.original:
12:20PM...

Sensing an unusual presence, the animals and birds of the land have begun to flee.

33.original:
There's nothing to be scared of.

We've become incomparably stronger compared to a year ago.

34.original: Okay! Let's head in the direction of their Ki!

37.original: Weren't there supposed to be only two Saiyans?!

40.original:
Oh, it's you...

Heh heh... What are you doing here? Come to get in the way?

41.original: Come on, Piccolo... I've progressed a bit since you last saw me.

42.original:
I can tell.

So, I guess more fools will try to show up?

43.original: Yeah, everyone will be here. I was the closest.

44.original: Krillin! I knew you'd come fight with us!

46.original: All right. Time to cut the chatter. Let's go!

48.original:
Heh heh... There they are!

Looks like another strong one joined them...

49.original: It seems they're well informed about us...

50.original:
So, those are the Saiyans?

I can feel their Ki. It's so strong...

It's overwhelming!

51.original: I see you've been waiting for us...

52.original:
Let me ask just in case...

What did you come here for?

53.original: That voice... You must be the one that defeated Raditz.

55.original: Didn't Raditz tell you? This machine is also a communications device.

57.original:
So it seems...

I guess it's not really that surprising that Raditz was defeated.

59.original:
Piccolo. Is it true...?

Are you an alien too?!

61.original:
Now I get it!

As well as having above average power levels, they say the Nameks also have special skills!

I've heard that some of them even have magical abilities...

You made the Dragon Balls, didn't you!

63.original:
Those Dragon Balls are our main goal. So hand 'em over!

Even if you are a Namek, you're just one.

You're like a fly to us!

64.original:
Heh... Thanks.

You've helped me understand who my ancestors were...

Sorry to disappoint you, but I didn't make the Dragon Balls.

Fighting is my specialty!

65.original: Come see if I'm really the fly you say I am!

67.original:
I had no idea...

I'm an alien... I knew I was different than everyone else... but...

68.original:
I was the one who made the Dragon Balls.

It was the first time I had made them, but I felt a sort of nostalgia...

It's possible that Dragon Balls were made on a different planet by those they call Namek.

The memory of those far off ancestors remained inside of me...

69.original:
I guess you have no intention of telling us where they are.

Fine. We'll just have to force it out of you.

70.original:
981... 1220... 1083...

Hah! You think you can take us on with power levels like that?!

71.original:
These Earthlings can control their power levels.

We can't rely on our scouters here.

72.original:
Oh, right...

Now I remember, that weakling Raditz got himself killed after letting his guard down.

74.original:
Raditz...

Wasn't he the Saiyan that took both you and Goku to take him down?

76.original:
That's right. So let's see just how strong these fools really are.

I'm sure that will help them in telling us where the Dragon Balls are.

77.original:
Hey, Nappa. There should be about six Saibamen left.

Take them out.

78.original: Heh heh heh... You sure know how to have fun, don't you Vegeta?

82.original: This soil should raise some good Saibamen.

87.original: Those three are the target. Make them suffer!

92.original: Well now, so you runts have friends...

93.original: Wasn't there supposed to only be just two Saiyans?

95.original:
Six of them... I like it! One for each human...

How about it? A one on one match with the Saibamen!

We could make a game out of it!

96.original:
A game?! Don't be ridiculous!

Let's not beat around the bush! We'll take you all on at once!

97.original:
Hold on, Piccolo! This could work out for us!

We could buy some time until Goku gets here!

98.original: Fine with me. I'll go first. Come and get it.

99.original:
Gah hah hah hah!

He's gonna be surprised to find out just how strong the Saibamen really are!

100.original:
You go! And don't hold back anything.

Got it?

104.original: My training must not have been enough...

108.original: Heh heh... I knew they'd provide us some entertainment.

110.original:
Wh-What the...?! The Saibamen's power level is supposed to be 1200!

They should all be as strong as Raditz was!

111.original: Then his power level is greater than that. It's that simple.

112.original: But! We had no data on this!

117.original:
There was no use in letting him continue. He would have lost.

That Saibaman didn't take his enemy seriously.

I told them not to hold back.

119.original: (That Saiyan... He reduced that green monster to pieces in a matter of seconds... What power!)

121.original: You guys better not hold back this time!

123.original:
Let me go.

I wanna show them we're not playing around.

125.original:
You've already been wished back by the Dragon Balls, Krillin.

If something happened, you won't be able to come back.

128.original: Show him what you Saibamen are really made of!

130.original:
Looks like these monsters weren't as strong as you thought.

I think I'll go ahead and clean up the remaining four as well...

131.original: Heh heh heh... Looks like you're the one who's underestimated us this time.

133.original: He blew himself up... I don't believe it!

136.original:
Yamcha must have had a bad feeling about the fight...

That's why he went in my place...

This can't be happening... What are we gonna tell Puar and Bulma...?

137.original:
These Saibamen are pathetic!

Why would they use that kind of move on these losers!

138.original: Hey! Why don't you clean up that dirty, piece of garbage there!

139.original:
......!

You'll regret that! Time to show you what I can do!

141.original: They're probably waiting somewhere for us... Let's go after them!

144.original: Heh heh heh... Time to get serious.

145.original: Let me take them, Vegeta. I'll clean all five of them up in no time!

147.original: Heh heh... I'm gonna have some fun with you guys.

150.original: How... How could he be this strong?!

152.original: I never thought they'd be this strong!

153.original: Now then... Who should I start with first?

156.original: Chiaotzu?! Where are you?! Did he get caught in the blast?!

160.original: What are you trying to do, Chiaotzu?! Get outta there! RUN AWAY!

166.original:
...A suicide attack like that takes some guts.

Not bad for a little guy...

168.original:
Heh heh heh... What a wimp...

Looks like you guys still don't understand what you're up against!

169.original: Uh oh... I've got a bad feeling!

171.original:
After I take out the guy with three eyes, you guys are next!

Heh heh... You'll all be good and dead!

172.original:
How...?!

There's not a scratch on him! That's not fair... Chiaotzu gave his life!

173.original:
Chiaotzu has already been wished back with the Dragon Balls...

He can't be brought back again!

174.original: Let me send you to the other side to visit the little rat! You can thank me later!

176.original:
Listen... He's gonna be vulnerable for just a second as he makes his attack...

That's where we'll aim for...

178.original: I wouldn't be looking away if I were you. You might miss your chance.

179.original:
You sure don't seem worried.

Keep smiling while you have the chance. Goku will change all of that when he gets here.

180.original: Oh really? Just who is this Goku? Someone special?

186.original: Idiot. Another useless attempt leads to another one dead...

187.original: It can't be... Can nothing kill this guy?!

188.original:
No... Not Tien... This is... a nightmare...

We keep dying one after the other...

189.original: GOKU! Hurry up and get here! PLEASE!

192.original: Gwah hah hah... That's another one down for the count... You guys are next...

193.original:
I'll just leave the Namek alive and breathing enough to tell us where the Dragon Balls are.

We'd like to ask you more about them.

194.original:
Lucky for you, Piccolo...

They think only you know about the Dragon Balls...

195.original: Doesn't make a difference... They'll kill us all in the end anyway.

196.original:
It sure is good to have you on our side in a situation like this...

Who'd of thought, you know?

So, you think we have at least a little chance at winning?

198.original:
I didn't think they'd be monsters of this magnitude.

They far surpass the Saiyan that came before them.

199.original: Looks like I might end up dying again...

200.original: What's taking him so long? Where are you Goku!

201.original: Can you not feel his presence yet?

202.original:
Hurry... I have but little time left...

Death draws ever closer...

205.original:
Heh heh heh... I wouldn't let your guard down if I were you...

If you won't go first, then I will!

210.original: Don't be in such a hurry. I've got something I want to ask them.

211.original:
The one you call Goku...

Are you talking about Kakarot?!

213.original:
I see.

So, what we heard on the scouters is true. He's been brought back to life.

Hah hah hah!

Who'd have thought that your savior was that weakling, Kakarot!

214.original: What do you expect him to do? He couldn't even stand up to Raditz!

215.original:
He should be a lot stronger now... No, he will be for sure!

Stronger beyond belief!

217.original:
Dah hah hah! Then where is he?

You sure he didn't run off scared?!

218.original:
He'll be here! My dad will be here, you'll see!

He'll take you down!

219.original: Heh heh... That's a lot of faith you've got there.

220.original: Interesting. Very well then. We'll wait until he arrives.

221.original:
What?! Are you kidding, Vegeta?

Don't be so boring! Kakarot won't show! Let's just take care of these guys right now!

223.original:
Three hours?! What're we gonna do for three hours?

I can't just stay still after sleeping all the way here!

There's no point in waiting!

224.original: This is stupid! I wanna play now!!

225.original: Nappa! Did you not hear what I said?!?!

226.original:
S-Sorry... Sorry, Vegeta...

I got a little... carried away...

227.original: Well, you heard me. I've extended your lives for a little bit longer. Be grateful.

228.original: But, Vegeta... Why are we waiting for someone like Kakarot?

229.original:
Kakarot is a back-stabbing Saiyan.

He must be punished.

We're going to kill his friends and son right in front of him.

After that we'll give him a lesson in slow death.

We'll show him just how powerless he is and make him writhe in anguish.

All in a few hours. Heh heh.

We should be able to give them all a hell of a show.

230.original: Now I get it! So that's the plan! Sounds good, Vegeta.

231.original: That's if he shows up in three hours...

232.original: You can have Kakarot, but let me have these three!

233.original:
Whatever you want.

But after we get the information about the Dragon Balls out of the Namek.

237.original: There it is! The end of Snake Way!

238.original: He made it to the other side! That was incredibly fast!

241.original: That Goku... He actually made it back from King Kai's place...

242.original: Well, here I go! I'm trained and ready for anything!

246.original: Here he comes! He's pretty worn out!

254.original: Good to see you, Nimbus! Let's go!

255.original: There's a lot of huge Ki all in one place! Over there!

257.original:
W-what?! This Ki!

There's a massive Ki force coming right this way!

258.original: Y-you're right... It's huge, but I think I remember it from somewhere!

259.original: Gehh! Quit giving me your stupid nonsense!

260.original: It's Goku... It's got to be him!

262.original:
Vegeta! Are they being serious?!

Heh heh heh! Is Kakarot actually coming this way?!

263.original:
I don't know if it's Kakarot or not.

But it'll be here in about four minutes...

And whoever it is, its power level is around 5000!

267.original:
Forget about them! I've got an idea!

We can just go to Planet Namek, home of the Namekians.

There's got to be an even stronger set of Dragon Balls on that planet!

If Kakarot's really alive, that means the legend's been true all along!

268.original:
Piccolo, run!

I'll hold him off until Daddy makes it here!

If you die, then Kami's gonna die too...

And then there won't be any more Dragon Balls!

269.original:
Heh... why do you have to be so stupid?

You know there's no way you can defend yourself against him.

271.original: You stupid brat! Don't make me laugh!

275.original:
It's been three hours...

What a waste of time... That coward Kakarot never showed...

277.original: Just great... Why isn't he here yet?

278.original:
Now then...

Time to turn on the pain! Just too bad we couldn't do the same for Kakarot...

279.original: Looks like I'll be dead soon too... I feel like I'm on a suicide mission...

280.original:
There's only one chance we have at beating this guy...

That's if it goes to plan...

281.original:
Krillin, first you do all you can to get their attention...

Then I'll take that opening to grab the Saiyan's tail... That's their weakness.

283.original:
That'll take his power down and make him helpless...

When that happens, Gohan, you hit him with all you've got! Got it?

284.original:
Got it!

It's OK... I won't run away this time!

285.original:
You'd better not!

Remember, the fate of the Earth is in your hands.

286.original:
(Wow, all right Piccolo! I'm starting to see the light!

We might just have a chance!)

287.original: Gohan, believe in yourself. If you really try, your power could even surpass mine...

293.original: I told you... I told you to run... Hurry... Get out of here...

294.original:
Don't die, Piccolo! My dad will be here soon!

Please... Don't die!!

295.original:
That fool!

I didn't mean to kill him just yet... Oh well... It was gonna happen sooner or later anyway.

296.original: One of the powers is fading! Someone's dying!

297.original:
Looks like my time has come... I suppose Goku didn't make it in time.

However... Piccolo managed to... Surpass even me... in the end...

He did well...

298.original:
How pathetic... The Demon King Piccolo's final moments...

...Were spent protecting a kid... What a joke... Heh heh heh...

299.original:
It's all Goku's fault... His weaknesses spread into me through you...

Gohan... Y-You were the only one who ever...

...Talked to me like I was someone...

300.original:
Th-The months we spent together were... all right...

Don't... die... Go... han...

302.original: The rest is up to you... Mr. Popo...

306.original: Power level 2800! I knew they could control their power!

308.original:
Not bad for a runt...

Heh heh... You made my arm go numb...

309.original:
His power level has gone down again...

Looks like he used up all of his energy...

311.original:
Piccolo... I'm sorry... I couldn't avenge you...

I don't even have enough energy to run...

313.original:
Gaaah hah hah!

I can't wait to see the look on Kakarot's face when he sees his mangled son!

319.original:
What is it you came for, Kakarot?

You can't possibly think you can defeat us.

322.original:
Are you upset that all your stupid friends are dead? No need to be sad.

You'll be joining them soon. It's too bad you just now came back to life...

324.original: Hey! What's wrong with you? You wanna die already? Well?!

325.original: Let me give you a proper greeting!

329.original:
Sorry I'm late, you guys.

You both did great... Here, split this...

330.original: Huh? Senzu beans... Korin still had some left...?

332.original: In that case, you eat it, Goku!

334.original:
Then... hold on to it just in case!

We wouldn't be able to help even if we ate these!

335.original: Don't worry, Krillin. If you don't want it, I'll just toss it!

338.original: Krillin, you've really improved. I can tell from your Ki...

339.original:
I thought I had too, but it was no use... Nothing worked against them.

They were too strong... They killed everyone right in front of us...

340.original: Gohan, you really have come a long way too! You must have trained hard!

341.original:
Yeah... Thanks to Piccolo...

But... I couldn't even do anything...

342.original:
Piccolo's dead... That means the Dragon Balls are gone...

We can't wish anyone back to life now...

343.original:
Those damn Saiyans... Let's all three of us teach them a lesson!

Now that Goku's here, we might just be able to take one of them down!

344.original: You trained with some really strong guy called King Kai, right?

345.original:
Yeah. But let me fight them alone.

You two step back and try not to get caught in the fight.

346.original:
?! You're gonna fight them alone?!

Not even you could do it alone!

Those guys are way stronger than you imagine!

348.original: Let's do what he says, Gohan. Goku knows what he's doing.

350.original: Don't worry about it, let's just go!

351.original:
(I've never seen Goku so angry...

We'd never be able to come between him...)

353.original: Your bark's a lot worse than your bite, isn't it?

356.original: (This is so bizarre... His power level's nothing like it was when he fought Raditz!)

358.original: Yep. I could tell from that last attack.

359.original:
Heh... heh heh heh... You think you've got me all figured out, huh?!

I'd like to know how you managed that!

364.original:
What's with the face? I don't like that look...

Heh heh heh... You really wanna die that bad?

369.original: 8000?! That can't be right! That thing must be broken!

370.original: Don't worry. I won't use the Kaioken on you...

372.original: You're no match for someone like me!

374.original:
Heh heh heh... better, you say?

I'm gonna shut that big mouth of yours for good! It's over, you!

375.original: Enough! You don't have what it takes to finish this! I'll take care of him!

376.original:
How pathetic...

I never thought I'd even have to lift a finger against you, Kakarot...

377.original:
He... he's finally serious...

Even that giant is a huge coward when faced with him...

378.original:
N-no... You were supposed to be nothing.

W-why did I need Vegeta to finish you off?

I've got my orders, so I'll leave the rest for Vegeta.

But don't think I'm gonna just leave without settling this...

379.original: ! Oh, no! I've got to save them!

382.original: I'm an Elite Warrior of noble birth! I won't let some Low-Class Warrior like you make a fool out of me!!

383.original: Wow! Goku's incredible! He might just win!

384.original:
Nappa, you fool! Calm down!

He won't be able to beat you if you stay level headed!

Compose yourself!

385.original:
......!

You're right! Thanks, Vegeta. You've opened my eyes...

386.original: (That simple minded fool! Looks like it'll be my turn soon at this rate...)

387.original:
I admit I lost it for a minute there...

But now it's time for the real show to start... You ready, Kakarot?

388.original: Finally... That's what I've been waiting for.

389.original: Heh heh. You think you're so tough?

390.original: (He doesn't just think he is. He knows it.)

392.original: He probably won't be able to fight anymore. Leave Earth now, and take him with you!

397.original: I've no need for a useless Saiyan! DIE!!!

400.original:
His Ki is incredible...

Greater than any enemy I've ever faced...
